description: On the bed in front of you there’s a large white plastic bench/chair part with several small white blocks and a larger connector piece nearby. The left hand stays planted on the main bench/chair piece to steady it, while the right hand reaches to the right, picks up a small white block, moves it inward and down, and presses it into a slot on top of the main piece, then loosens its grip and hovers above as if checking the fit.
